title: Stop demanding authored evidence at cap, keep every build-emitted proof
action: This is the cell the whole feature exists for. Make exactly TWO throws in capCell non-blocking, and not one more. (1) The behavior_change-without-evidence refusal at cells.mjs:1956-1960. (2) Decision 0004's 'no recorded proof / an assertion is not evidence' refusal at cells.mjs:2164-2168. In both places the cap now SUCCEEDS and the absence is recorded on the cell rather than refused (per D1) — the marker for that is already built: trace.proof = "unrecorded" from wc-1, which arms the feature-boundary close-door without buying any door bypass (per D12). Do not invent a second marker. Emit a non-blocking warning alongside, in the shape of the existing ratio warning, so the absence is visible in the cap output and not only in the cell file. WHAT MUST NOT MOVE, and this is most of the work: the non-empty files_changed refusal at cells.mjs:2169-2173 stays refusing — it asks what the worker touched, not for authored proof (per D1). The red-first tier stays exactly as it is: security and migration in every lane, and every class in lane high-risk, still refuse without red_failure_evidence at :2135 (per D2). The new-test-file rules stay: refactor and formatting still refuse a new test file outright with no override, and any other class still needs new_suite_reason of at least 20 chars (per D6). The ratio ceiling stays (per D6). No bypass level gains power over anything. D7 is non-negotiable and ships IN THIS CELL, not after it: a table-driven negative-control pair in the shape at test_cells.mjs:2189-2239 — one cases array proving the widened paths now cap (behavior_change true with no evidence; small, standard and high-risk lanes with a verify recorded but no output), and a second cases array proving every heavier tier STILL refuses (security and migration any lane, high-risk any class, refactor plus a new test file, a new suite file with no reason, over-ratio at standard and above). A guard loosened without a negative control is a guard nobody can prove still exists. Also close the seam wc-1's worker flagged: once these two throws go non-blocking, a small/standard/high-risk cap and a behavior_change cap become markable for the first time, so add rows proving the refusal-removed path really does produce trace.proof = "unrecorded" and really does arm the close-door, driving a real cap rather than a hand-written cell file. This cell owns its regen chain — run the plugin skill-tree render, then the onboarding apply, then the release-manifest write, in that order, before capping.
